views.markdown: Custom image-based lock screen clocks for rootless iOS 15. Choose your style with animated digit packs, or import your own.

### Features
- Static and animated digit packs
- Import and manage custom packs
- Animation speed and Low Power Mode options
- Digit size, spacing and vertical offset
- System, 12-hour and 24-hour time formats with optional seconds
- Optional date hiding and tint colors
- English, Ukrainian and Russian localization

### Compatibility
Rootless iOS 15. Includes arm64 and arm64e binaries. Confirmed working on iPhone 7 Plus (iOS 15.8.8), iPhone 12 (iOS 15.3.1), and iPhone 13 Pro Max (iOS 15.1.1). Other devices and iOS 15 versions require testing. The seconds display has been verified on iPhone 7 Plus; it has not yet been separately verified on the other listed devices.

Promotional screenshots have been translated into English.

### Version 1.0.1
- Added optional seconds display
- Added arm64e builds for the tweak and preferences bundle to fix settings loading on compatible devices
Support is entirely optional and does not unlock additional features. Inspired by FlexClock; artwork from AniTime and credited pack creators.
